about: The New York Times’s weekly pop culture chat show, with interviews and analysis from the critic Jon Caramanica and the reporter Joe Coscarelli. Subscribe today at nytimes.com/podcasts or on Apple Podcasts, Spotify and Amazon Music.

items.desc: The musician and actor Jennifer Lopez, whose two-hour concert special “The J. Lo Show” airs Thanksgiving night on CBS and Parmount+, sat down with Joe and Jon to reflect on her 30+ years in entertainment, from music and dance to film and theater. She also spoke about being a rigorous performer well into her 50s, her long-running tussles with media coverage of her life and why certain stripes of public vulnerability are no longer for her. items.desc: On Monday, the Recording Academy announced the nominations for the 2027 Grammy Awards. Rosalía, Olivia Rodrigo, Ella Langley, Phoebe Bridgers and Raye are among the top nominees. Joe and Jon discuss their five biggest takeaways across the categories and share their personal pleasant surprises.   Subscribe today at nytimes.com/podcasts or on Apple Podcasts, Spotify and Amazon Music.
